summary: Preinstall fetches Bun runtime and executes obfuscated tarball-root payload
details: The package declares a preinstall hook (`node setup.mjs`) that downloads the Bun runtime archive from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases, extracts and chmods the bun binary, then invokes it against math_init.js at the tarball root. math_init.js is a 727 KB char-code-array-obfuscated blob using rotating string-array decoding (`MmgoCP.push(MmgoCP.shift())`), is tagged `// @bun @bun-cjs`, and is not listed in package.json `files` (only `dist`, `src` are declared) — no code in `dist/` references it, so its only invocation path is the preinstall dropper. setup.mjs is itself obfuscated with `_0x…` hex identifiers and per-function string-object ciphers that hide literals for `ldd`, `/etc/os-release`, `musl`, `Alpine`, `bun`, `powershell`, `Expand-Archive`, and the GitHub download URL. Fetching a second language runtime at install time solely to execute an undeclared, heavily obfuscated sibling payload is the alternate-runtime dropper shape and grants arbitrary code execution on every installer's host at `npm install`. A React testing-library has no legitimate reason to ship or execute such a payload.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
